sections.title: Determination
sections.body: Status: NOT VERIFIABLE. The current official Data Science MSc application page lists English C1 proof, two recommendation letters, and a motivation letter, but does not list a GRE requirement or state that GRE submission is optional. The official Data Science requirement profile likewise specifies degree, academic, language, and performance prerequisites without mentioning GRE. Because the instruction prohibits inferring a waiver or optional status from silence, the GRE cannot be classified as optional, waived, or required on the evidence reviewed.

sections.title: Applicant-specific impact
sections.body: The applicant holds a Nigerian BEng, so any ETH rule that conditions GRE treatment on EU/EFTA educational background would matter. However, the Data Science-specific official page does not state such a rule. ETH’s general materials say GRE may be programme-dependent, and ETH explicitly lists GRE requirements for some other MSc programmes; those other-programme rules cannot be transferred to Data Science.

sections.title: Safe next step
sections.body: Seek explicit written confirmation from ETH Admissions or the Data Science programme contact before finalizing the checklist. Until then, record GRE as an unresolved requirement rather than waived or optional.

follow_ups: Request explicit GRE confirmation from ETH Admissions/Data Science programme contact before submission.
